6-Day Southwest Turkey Adventure: Coast to Cappadocia
summary:
The 6-Day Istanbul & Cappadocia Tour gives you time to experience two very different sides of Turkey without packing too much into each day. In Istanbul, explore Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace and the historic Sultanahmet district, followed by a Bosphorus cruise. Then fly to Cappadocia to discover its fairy chimneys, rock-cut valleys and remarkable underground cities.
You can choose the dates that work for your trip, with adjustments available when required. Your arrangements include selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, two domestic flights, airport transfers, entrance fees and the guided visits shown in the itinerary.

itinerary.title: Flight to Izmir & Ephesus tour
itinerary.text:
At 04:00, transfer to Istanbul Airport for your morning flight to Izmir at 07:00.
Upon arrival at 08:10, meet your guide and continue to Ephesus, one of the best-preserved Greco-Roman ancient cities in the world. Explore its marble streets, the magnificent Library of Celsus, and the impressive Great Theatre. The tour also includes visits to the sacred House of the Virgin Mary and the remains of the Temple of Artemis. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale Tour & Transfer to Antalya
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces, known as the “Cotton Castle,” and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, continue with a 4-hour intercity coach journey to Antalya. Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Antalya Ancient Cities Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:00, depart for a full-day tour of Antalya and the ancient Pamphylia region. Visit the remarkable ancient cities of Side, Perge, and Aspendos, famous for their impressive Roman ruins, including the well-preserved theatres and the largest stadium in Asia Minor. Continue to the scenic Manavgat Waterfall before returning to the hotel. Overnight in Antalya.

itinerary.title: Antalya City Tour & Overnight Coach
itinerary.text: After breakfast, pick up from your hotel around 08:00 for a full-day tour of Antalya. Enjoy a ride on the Tnektepe Teleferik for panoramic Mediterranean views, then visit Düden Waterfalls and Karpuzkaldıran Waterfall. After lunch, explore the historic old town of Kaleici. After the tour, transfer to the main bus station for your overnight coach to Cappadocia at 21:00.

itinerary.title: Arrival & North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text: At 06:00, arrival in Göreme, where you will be met and transferred to your hotel (check-in after the tour). At 10:00, begin a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle, Pasabag, the Zelve Open Air Museum, Devrent Valley, and Three Beauties. Continue to the towns of Urgup and Avanos, famous for traditional pottery-making. Optional visit to a Turkish rug and carpet workshop. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia Tour & Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soganlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. After the tour, transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Istanbul at 18:30. Upon arrival at 20:00, meet and transfer to hotel.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 6-Day Ephesus, Pamukkale, Antalya & Cappadocia Travel package?
faqs.a: The 6-Day Ephesus, Pamukkale, Antalya & Cappadocia Travel package covers four of Turkey's most remarkable destinations: Antalya, Cappadocia, Pamukkale, and Ephesus. You will explore Antalya's Mediterranean coastline and historic old town, discover Cappadocia's fairy chimneys, visit Pamukkale's white travertine terraces, and walk through the ancient city of Ephesus. The tour runs for 5 nights and 6 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 6-Day Ephesus, Pamukkale, Antalya & Cappadocia Travel package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,395 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, two domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in this 6-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights to help reduce travel time between destinations. These flights allow you to spend more time exploring Antalya, Cappadocia, Pamukkale, and Ephesus while enjoying a comfortable travel experience.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 5 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers are included throughout the itinerary.

faqs.q: Does the 6-day tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. As a small-group tour, you benefit from a more personalized experience while learning about Turkey's history, culture, and natural wonders from knowledgeable local guides.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is an excellent choice for first-time visitors who want to experience a diverse range of Turkey's highlights. It combines ancient cities, natural wonders, unique landscapes, and Mediterranean coastal scenery into one well-balanced itinerary.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the 6-day tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, and uneven terrain at locations such as Ephesus, Pamukkale, and Cappadocia. Most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: Can I add a hot air balloon ride in Cappadocia?
faqs.a: The Cappadocia hot air balloon ride is not included in the standard package but can be arranged as an optional activity. Since balloon flights are weather-dependent and highly sought after, advance reservations are strongly recommended.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Ephesus, Pamukkale, Antalya & Cappadocia Travel package?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 6-Day Ephesus, Pamukkale, Antalya & Cappadocia Travel package available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can extend your stay in any destination, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
